description: This script sets up and runs a Docker container to perform end-to-end testing of the OpenClaw project. It builds a Docker image, overrides system commands like systemctl and loginctl, installs the openclaw npm package globally from a local source, and runs testing flows to verify the correct behavior of the openclaw service entrypoints.

methods.name: assert_entrypoint
methods.description: Checks the ExecStart entrypoint of a systemd service unit file against an expected value.

methods.name: run_flow
methods.description: Runs a test flow by installing the service with one entrypoint, then running the doctor command with another, verifying the entrypoint switch.
